Name: Zero Gravity Y3030
Overview: The Year is 3030 and you are a glorified futuristic forklift driver, in space. It's a perilous job, with low safety standards and ridiculously high risk but the money is good and training is optional. You've just landed a contract and your boss doesn't hold you in high regard; your not even sure if your Lifter is air tight. The decent of your life, is really up to you. A huge 3D space simulation.
